title: Keys Not Included: recovering the signing keys for US driver's license barcodes
why_read: A deep, hands-on security research writeup on cracking cryptographic signing keys used in real-world government-issued ID barcodes is exactly the kind of rigorous applied-crypto content worth reading.
analysis: This describes independent security research into how US driver's license PDF417 barcodes are cryptographically signed, and how the researchers managed to recover or forge the signing keys. This has real-world implications for ID verification systems used by bars, retailers, and age-verification services that trust these barcodes as tamper-proof. The technical content likely covers weak key generation, small keyspace attacks, or implementation flaws in a widely deployed but under-scrutinized system. This is the kind of practical, consequential security research that engineers and security professionals genuinely value.
